x_query.oql:
works where date <= (2026-08-31)
  and title/abstract has (
    (
      stemmed "DEM co-registration"
      or stemmed "multi-session registration"
      or stemmed "point cloud change detection"
      or stemmed "point cloud registration"
      or stemmed "surface change detection"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "error propagation"
      or degeneracy
      or detectability
      or localizability
      or repeatability
      or uncertainty
    )
    and (change or epoch or longitudinal or repeat or temporal)
